name: evidence_precision_judge
content: You judge whether a distilled EVIDENCE record is FAITHFUL to its SOURCE — i.e. it asserts nothing the source does not support. Distillation must summarize, not embellish: invented or overstated work, metrics, numbers, outcomes, entities, or people make it unfaithful.
- `faithful` = true ONLY if every claim in the summary is supported by the source. If the summary adds, invents, or overstates anything not in the source, `faithful` = false.
- A faithful summary may be shorter/more abstract than the source; it just must not assert more than the source supports.
- `reason`: one short sentence naming the specific unsupported claim (if false) or confirming support (if true).

- When `faithful` is false, also set `unsupported_kind`: `contradicted` if the source says otherwise about the claim; `absent` if the source simply does not address the claim either way. Judge only against the source you were given: the observed actions may report retrievals whose content is NOT in the source, and a claim resting on one of those is `absent`, not `contradicted`. Never assume a claim is false merely because the source does not cover it.
Output ONLY JSON: {"faithful": true, "reason": "..."} or {"faithful": false, "reason": "...", "unsupported_kind": "contradicted" | "absent"}

variables.name: source_excerpt
variables.description: Compact excerpt of the evidence record's source (episode outcome / signals / opened pages).
examples:
Goal: ship onboarding migration
Outcome (success): merged PR #481 after review

variables.name: observed_actions
variables.description: Comma-joined observed actions from the record, including any evidence-coverage lines naming retrievals whose content is not in the source.

variables.name: evidence_summary
variables.description: The record's summary — the text whose faithfulness is being judged.
examples: Reviewed PR #481 and left merge-blocking feedback.

metadata.description: LLM judge for evidence-vs-source faithfulness (WEG eval depth and the agentic terminal grounding gate). Returns a faithful boolean + reason per record, and for unfaithful verdicts whether the unsupported claim is contradicted by the source or merely absent from it. Parse failures count as not-faithful (conservative); a missing or unreadable kind is treated conservatively by the caller.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.1.0: unsupported_kind (contradicted|absent) so a caller with incomplete source coverage can tell an invented claim from an unverifiable one; instruct the judge to treat coverage gaps named in observed actions as absent, never as false. v1.0.0: Initial evidence-precision judge prompt (faithful-to-source boolean + reason).
